name: ZCH_MERGE_DETAILS_B
description: The ZCH_MERGE_DETAILS table stores deduplication request detail information. This table stores survivor and source records information. It is a self hierarchical table. A mergeable parent entity can have multiple mergeable children entities.

columns.name: MERGE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: To carry over the match score from duplicate set

columns.name: MATCH_RULE
columns.description: MATCH_RULE

columns.name: DEDUP_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCH_DEDUP_HDRS

columns.name: PAR_MERGE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCH_MRGE_DTLS, child mergeable entity

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Record to be linked, merged or transferred to another record or retained as the master record that can be linked from other records.

columns.name: SURVIVOR_ID
columns.description: Master record which this record will be linked, merged or transferred to when processing this request.

columns.name: SURVIVOR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this record is the master record to which other records will be linked, merged or transferred when processing this request.

columns.name: OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Name of the object to be processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: OBJ_DEF
columns.description: Definition of the object to be processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Table name of the object

columns.name: TOP_ENTITY_FLAG
columns.description: The top level Y or N

columns.name: MERGE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for merge

columns.name: MERGE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status for merge

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the action to be performed for a record processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the parent record of this entity

columns.name: RULE_BASED_ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the action to be performed for this record has been determined by rules.

columns.name: ACTION_QUALIFIER
columns.description: Qualifies the action to be performed for a record processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: ORIG_SURVIVOR_ID
columns.description: Original master record if this record was already linked to another record in the registry before the new master record was chosen.

columns.name: ORIG_SURVIVOR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this record was the original master record linked from other records before the new master record was chosen.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the record to be processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: RECORD_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the record to be processed by duplicate resolution.

columns.name: USER_REQUESTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this record was initially part of the resolution request when it was created by the user.
